card.name: The word "as" after a dose
card.fires_on: The word "as" right after a dose or amount, introducing the form or way it is given or supplied (as a single dose, as an infusion, as the trihydrate).

modes.label: Dose given as a schedule or route
modes.description: "as" after a daily dose or "administer", leading to how the dose is given (single, divided, infusion, injection).
modes.example: The usual adult dosage is 25 mg to 100 mg daily<< as>> a single or divided dose.

modes.label: Amount supplied as a form or salt
modes.description: "as" after an amount of a drug, naming the product form or salt.
modes.example: Each 5 mL will contain 600 mg of amoxicillin<< as>> the trihydrate, and 42
